name: tia_create_technology_object
description: Create a technology object in the PLC's 'Technology objects' folder (TechnologicalObjects.Create). type is the Openness system-library name: PID_Temp, PID_Compact, PID_3Step (TO_PID_Temp, TO_PID_Compact and TO_PID_3Step are mapped to these); other names are passed to TIA unchanged and TIA rejects unsupported ones. version is required, there is no automatic latest: S7-1200 (FW >= 4.2) supports PID_Temp 1.1, PID_Compact 2.3 or later and PID_3Step 2.3; check the TIA documentation for other CPUs. Fails without changing anything if any technology object or block already has the name (case-insensitive); never overwrites or deletes. A PID instance DB created from an SCL call is a plain instance DB, not a technology object: rename or delete it first or pick another name. Creating the object does not call it: call it from a cyclic interrupt OB with the object's name as instance, e.g. "PID_Temp_1"(Setpoint := ..., Input := ...); hardware inputs and outputs are wired through those call parameters. Motion and counting objects are created without any hardware interconnection.

type.description: System-library name of the technology object, e.g. 'PID_Temp', 'PID_Compact' or 'PID_3Step'.

name.description: Name for the new technology object, e.g. 'PID_Temp_1'.

version.description: Technology-object version as major.minor, e.g. '1.1' or 'V1.1' for PID_Temp on S7-1200.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name (case-sensitive); required when the project has multiple PLCs.
